scope: Opt-in local translation trial; production defaults unchanged
input: Complete source units and applicable terminology; no translation references exposed to drafting
phase1: Produce complete draft, source-anchored provisional invariants and scoped fixed phrases
phase2: Independently recheck source, improve Chinese wording and validate each invariant; correct source-inconsistent draft assertions
delivery: Preserve final candidate text verbatim; validate identity, exact evidence, fixed phrases, Markdown, dice and links through delivery_gate release
limits: Structural checks do not establish semantic correctness, naturalness or original-name mapping correctness. Independent source-based review remains required.
retention: Use a fresh run directory; keep source and output hashes; do not overwrite frozen runs
publication: No automatic publication, remote writes or changes to production defaults
